2. Short facts are that one Jabed Ali as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 210 of 1962 in the Court of Sadar Munsif, 1st Court, Sylhet on 25-2-1962 for declaration of title to the suit land along with prayer for recovery of khas possession thereof. Subsequently, the suit was transferred to the Court of Assistant Judge, Beanibazar, Sylhet and was renumbered as Title Suit No. 247 of 1984. 

 3. The case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Probhat Chandra Das Chowdhury and others. The suit land was auction sold for non-payment of rent. The plaintiff auction purchased the same on 26-9-1953 and the auction sale was confirmed on 24-11-1953. There- after, a symbolic possession was delivered on 12-2-1954. The plaintiff tried his best for physical possession to the suit land since his purchase but the defendants did not allow him to go into possession of the suit land. Hence, the instant suit for decree of title and khas possession thereof.
